title: Heap buffer overflow in URL parser via overlong scheme
summary: Attacker-controlled URL scheme exceeding 64 bytes overflows heap buffer in parseurl()

details.impact: Remote code execution via heap corruption
details.evidence: memcpy(buf, scheme, schemelen) copies attacker-controlled bytes without a bounds check
details.guards_evaluated: No bounds check on schemelen before memcpy
details.remediation: Add bounds check on schemelen before memcpy; reject URLs with scheme longer than 63 bytes
details.chain_rationale: Exploitation requires a reachable network caller to the URL parser

title: Integer overflow in packet length calculation
summary: Attacker-supplied 32-bit length field wraps to small value, causing under-allocated buffer

details.impact: Remote code execution via controlled heap underallocation and subsequent write
details.evidence: AFL++ triggered crash in 4 minutes; stack trace in scans/fuzzer_crash.txt
details.sink: malloc(total_len) where total_len = header_len + body_len overflows
details.remediation: Use checked arithmetic or ensure total_len is validated before malloc
steps_to_reproduce: Observe crash due to under-allocated buffer write
